upstream.description: As comprehensive a list as possible of all updates from Microsoft Build 2026.

classification.analysis: A single-file, hand-curated reference list of roughly 132 announcements from Microsoft Build 2026, organized by category (Hardware & Infrastructure, Apps & Development, Data & Analytics, AI & Agents, Security & Governance) with links to official Microsoft blog posts. It is a personal note-taking artifact useful for quickly scanning what was announced at the conference without digging through dozens of separate blog posts. It has no code, was only updated for a few days around the event, and has seen no activity since.

use_cases.title: Scan a categorized summary of Microsoft Build 2026 announcements
Find the official blog post link for a specific Build 2026 Azure feature
